thread:
anya: Heads-up — kicking off a scoping thread for the 'Optimize playbook' (batching, caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts) for Q2. Need to prioritize features, define MVP and launch criteria. Quick takes please.

raja: Love it. Customers are explicitly asking for per-route batching suggestions, quant profiles per model family, and eval alarms that map to a route. @anya do we prioritize latency-sensitive apps or cost-heavy ones first? :thinking_face:

taylor: My vote = latency-sensitive first. If we provide safe batching + cache defaults tuned for p50/p95 SLOs, teams adopt faster. Cost mode can be an additional profile.

jess: From CS — top asks right now: AcmeHealth wants eval-triggered alerts tied to specific domain eval sets; RetailCo wants quant recs per throughput tier and a simple UI to accept/reject.

mike: Engineering caveat: real-time eval-triggered alerts (streaming) require eval hooks + streaming pipelines + retention. MVP idea: daily/periodic eval sweeps with alerting to Console/Slack, lower infra complexity.

eva-researcher: Also want to bake-in quality-preserving quant suggestions. Approach: run a small calibration benchmark per model (few-shot eval set) to estimate perf delta at safe 8-bit and aggressive 4-bit. Recommend thresholds like <=1% task-metric drop or <=0.5% perplexity increase to classify "safe".

anya: Proposed MVP (short):
- per-route batching/capacity recs (suggest batch_size, concurrency limits)
- prefix/KV cache suggestions (ttl, hit-rate target, when to enable)
- quant profiles: safe vs aggressive with measured perf deltas surfaced
- eval-alerts: daily sweep + Slack/email alerts + links to failing evals
Launch criteria: docs + 5 beta customers + <=10% regressions on their eval baselines and Console visibility (token-cost delta, latency delta). Thoughts?

raja: Add to launch criteria: Console shows token-cost delta and latency pctiles pre/post suggestion, and rollout feature flag with canary controls. Without observability, customers won't trust automated recs. :eyes:

taylor: Agree. And for scope negotiation: MVP must NOT auto-apply quant — recommendations only, require explicit opt-in. We can prototype an "auto-apply" later behind an enterprise toggle.

jess: Customers are also asking for an example config/API payload they can paste. Suggest we include something like:```json
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "suggested_batch": 16,
  "concurrency_limit": 4,
  "quant_profile": "safe-8bit",
  "cache_ttl_s": 300
}
```
This helps conversations with security and infra teams.

deploy-bot: Reminder — draft RFC for implementation due by 1792170000. :alarm_clock: Please add owners in the RFC.

anya: Action items: @raja draft the PRD with metrics and UX flows; @eva produce the quant calibration test plan and example eval sets; @taylor write the ops runbook for daily sweeps and alerting; @mike estimate infra cost and feasibility for daily vs streaming evals. I'll coordinate beta roster with CS (jess). Ping me if blocked.

mike: :thumbsup: will estimate infra cost, storage needs, and data retention tradeoffs by EOD Fri.
